chunks: When man is afflicted with adversity he turns to his Lord, and prays to Him. But when He bestows His favour on him, he forgets what he prayed for before, and sets up others as compeers of God to mislead (people) from His way. Say: "Take advantage of your denying for a while: You will be among the inmates of Hell."
ai.seo_question: How does human behavior change between times of hardship and times of ease according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the psychological shift from desperate supplication to arrogant forgetfulness, illustrating how divine blessings can become a test of gratitude. The command 'Enjoy your brief period of disbelief' underscores the transient nature of worldly ease compared to the eternal consequence of associating partners with God, a theme central to the concept of *fitrah* and human nature.
